nom: Murad Rapid Relief Acne Spot Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone oily skin report the product works well and that flakiness or dryness after use is a minor, manageable issue for their skin type.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several describe burning, red marks, worsened acne, and peeling severe enough to warn others off, while a few say it works overnight with no irritation.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report positive results, including reduced breakouts and pimples clearing overnight, with some noting drying or peeling afterward.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s calls it a holy grail she wishes she'd had in her youth, reporting reduced pimples despite some peeling.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual pimples or spots shrinking or disappearing within hours to a few days of overnight application; a few report no change or the spot getting bigger and scarring.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe cystic or hormonal blemishes reduced in size and pain by morning; some report the opposite, with blemishes worsening, developing whiteheads, or scarring after use.
concerns.barrier: Numerous reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report burning, peeling, or the top layer of skin drying and flaking off after application; some experienced this only on certain areas of the face.
concerns.dehydration: Frequent reports of dryness, itchiness, and flaking at the application site, generally described as expected and manageable with a moisturizer, though a couple found it excessive.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and swelling around treated spots, though a few state the product left red marks, scarring, or made redness worse.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with very oily skin reports no clogging of pores and says the drying effect is less of a concern for her skin type.

aspects.libelle: Overnight or rapid reduction of spots
Small amount needed, tube lasts long

extraits.texte: If you have sensitive skin like mine DO NOT USE this product it will dry the pimple overnight but it will burn the skin around !! It is not worth the money I paid for it

Frist things first, I have sensitive skin and I used the product alone with no other treatment. I purchased this for my hormonal pimples. I used it two night in a row. I did feel the swelling go down but that's about it. My skin peeled in those areas so noticeably. Additionally, it created these massive dark spots in the areas. I would rinse the areas in the morning because of the salicylic acid. I feel like it just clogged my pore extensively and extended the life of the pimple. I got this maybe 4 weeks ago and one of the pimples just popped with pus and so much blood. Maybe I used it incorrectly but its probably not suitable for hormonal pimples.

I fought stress- related, painful, cystic acne on my chin for 2 years and couldn't find anything to help me until I was shown this product + the clarifying cleanser. I've been using both for 5 years now. This spot treatment works quickly and effectively on my hyper sensitive, combo- oily skin. I will say that on my deeper, stress induced breakouts, I have to apply much more product (2 thick layers) and this does cause some peeling post-pimple. However; the pain is gone when I wake up and the size of the pimple is significantly reduced (or gone, if I applied in time) the next morning. I've found that it doesn't play well with my foundation, so if I'm desperate, I have to give it more time to absorb than I my moisturizer. Pros far outweigh these minor inconveniences now that I've learned how to work with it!

I just got this & used it last night, and had to write a review cause it is amazing. I'm 30 and still struggle with acne due to my very oily skin and easily-clogged pores, and it's particularly bad when I'm stressed or on my period. Put this on my pimples after my usual routine, woke up this morning and every one was significantly smaller, less red, etc. I know other reviewers said it dried them out, but if you've got really oily skin like me, I don't think you'll have to worry. And I used such a small amount that I think this tube could easily last me most of a year.

I have trouble with the painful, cystic acne, particularly around my chin and if I catch it fast enough, especially when it hurts but isn't visible yet, it'll vanish within a few hours. The sooner, the better but it'll reduce them at any stage. It will make my skin peel after several applications (some of my blemishes are pretty tough). It has a medicine-y type of smell that fades as it dries. I love that it's clear. I'm 44 and wish I had this in my youth!

I've always struggled with acne growing up especially through the puberty years. My face stays mostly oily but can also be considered combination skin type. I have fairly large pores that I'm constantly trying to maintain. With that being said, I do get some pretty deep, painful pimples every now and then. This is what I use for that problem and it works WONDERS! Sometimes, I'll have a painful but not visible pimple coming up that I'll apply this to morning and night. Typically, it works best at night. When I wake up, it's usually completely gone. The only issue I would be concerned about is that after that area has cleared, it does cause some flakiness for a few days. As mentioned earlier, I have mostly oily skin so it's not a huge issue for me but I could see it being an issue for other skin types. I would recommend this product for oily skin types and some combination skin types.

extraits.titre: Idk why it's not working for me :/ beware!
extraits.texte: I got this because I was in store looking for pimple stickers (I usually use the cosrx ones and they are miracle workers) and they didn't have stickers but the associate recommended this. She said it clears her acne in a matter of days so I got it to give it a try. I had a bit of a whitehead forming a bit deeper under my skin so I put it on. It drained the majority of the pimple but it left a red scar where the pimple was. I thought maybe I used it wrong so I tried again with another pimple. Not only did this other pimple get bigger and more painful the next day, but after the second night/by the third day, my pimple had so much red scrapping around it and it didn't drain. I left it until my cosrx would arrive in the mail, but unfortunately before they got to my house, that pimple's outer scabbing flaked off and now I'm sure it'll leave a scar. I'm really upset because right in the middle of my cheek so I hope it'll heal and not leave too much damage. But yea, I wouldn't recommend this at all. I don't even have particularly sensitive skin, and this just burned my skin right off.
